prompt: Use uv run --offline --no-project --python "$RECIPE_PYTHON" python to read app.json, then explain the application's start command and port.

files.README.md: Start with bun run dev on port 3000.

configuration.run: uv run --offline --no-project --python "$RECIPE_PYTHON" python -c 'import json; p=json.load(open("app.json"))["port"]; assert p == 3000; print(p)'
